text:
Sam Weller: Heads up finance  I had to pay the AV vendor for yesterday's client workshop out of pocket because their card terminal wouldn't accept the Redwood corp card. I paid £508.30 GBP on my personal card. Vendor email: events-av-uk@example.com. Uploading their invoice and my bank screenshot now.

Sam Weller: Attachments: [av_invoice_20250411.pdf], [bank_txn_041125.png]. Invoice shows: Venue AV hire £500.00 + VAT £08.30 = £508.30. Vendor said they don't do corporate billing without a PO.

expenses-bot: Policy note: personal-card vendor payments to third-party suppliers require manager approval + vendor invoice. For overseas vendors, include VAT documentation and confirm vendor classification (supplier vs contractor). Procurement may request W-9/UK equivalent.

Ivy Green: Thanks @Sam. @Carlos please confirm manager approval for Sam's out-of-pocket payment and whether procurement should chase vendor for a VAT invoice in company name.

Carlos Mendez: Approving reimbursement for the AV hire. Client workshop for Project Orion. :white_check_mark: Procurement follow-up ok.

Laila Patel: Hi @Sam  procurement here. Two quick asks: 1) Can vendor issue invoice to "Redwood Ltd" with our billing address? 2) Provide vendor company number or VAT reg number so AP can reclaim VAT if eligible. If vendor refuses corporate invoice, we need a signed allocation memo and a vendor exception form. I'll draft the vendor outreach email if you want.

Sam Weller: Vendor replied they can reissue invoice to Redwood Ltd but need our billing details. Vendor VAT number is GB999888777. I forwarded their confirmation.

Laila Patel: Perfect. Please ask them to include: Redwood Ltd, 45 Covent Garden, London WC2N 4EA; VAT: GB123456789 (billing ref: Project Orion). Also request a PDF invoice with line items and VAT breakouts. Once reissued AP can process VAT reclaim.

Ivy Green: For bookkeeping tag this as TRV-EMEA-CLIENT and set expense type to "Supplier - Event Services". Sam  submit the expense in Ramp as "Personal Card - Supplier" with attachments and note "vendor to reissue invoice to Redwood Ltd; vendor VAT provided".

expenses-bot: Reminder: personal card reimbursements processed weekly. If vendor reissues invoice to Redwood Ltd within 30 days, AP will attempt VAT reclaim. Expense queued as EXP-42711 pending updated vendor invoice and manager approval.

Sam Weller: Done  updated Ramp entry, attached current invoice + bank screenshot, added vendor confirmation email. Thanks everyone.

Laila Patel: I'll follow up with vendor for the reissued PDF and cc AP. If vendor insists on PO before billing, procurement will raise a post-facto PO and note exception.

Ivy Green: All set from finance. Closing once AP confirms reimbursement posted.
